result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count no longer includes cancelled purchase orders. The full offline test suite (`mvn -q -o test`) passes. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example, so that case hasn't been run.

The change is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart07.java`. The count subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the quarterly purchase-order reports use. Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, and the ordering is unchanged. I also added a short note about cancelled orders to the method's Javadoc.
